assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is performed with CPT code 93229
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The service is a diagnostic procedure directly indicated by the patient's known cardiac conditions and recurrent dizziness, as documented in the clinical indication note
